name: sistema-escoltas
description: Orquestador local del Sistema de Escoltas: backend Node/Express + frontend React/Vite

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
